skills.name: Teleportation
skills.detail: Interrupts an allied Doll and <Color=#44b164>teleports</color> them to the selected empty tile

skills.name: Teleportation - Offensive
skills.detail: Interrupts an allied Doll and <Color=#44b164>teleports</color> them to the selected empty tile. After successful movement, their damage dealt is increased by {1}% for {0} seconds

skills.name: Teleportation - Survival
skills.detail: Interrupts an allied Doll and <Color=#44b164>teleports</color> them to the selected empty tile. After successful movement, the regain HP equal to {0}% of Max HP

skills.name: Bit-Space Leap
skills.detail: Interrupts an allied Doll and <Color=#44b164>teleports</color> them to the selected empty tile

skills.name: Cyclonic Gust
skills.detail: The selected target is interrupted and sent airborne for {0} seconds. They cannot be targeted during this period.

skills.name: Cyclonic Gust - Concealment
skills.detail: The selected target is interrupted and sent airborne for {0} seconds. They cannot be targeted during this period. If the target is an ally, they will become invisible for {1} seconds after landing.

skills.name: Cyclonic Gust - Stun
skills.detail: The selected target is interrupted and sent airborne for {0} seconds. They cannot be targeted during this period. If the target is an enemy unit, they will be Stunned for {1} seconds after landing.

skills.name: Cyclonic Gust – Phantasm
skills.detail: The selected target is interrupted and sent airborne for {0} seconds. They cannot be targeted during this period. If the target is an enemy unit, they are stunned for {1} seconds after landing. Summons 2 Spirits next to the target to assist in battle. Their Max HP is equal to {2}% of the HP of the Doll with the greatest Hashrate, and inherit {3}% of that unit's ATK and Hashrate.

skills.name: Rapid Recharge
skills.detail: Select an ally Doll to cast their Auto Skill immediately. This does not affect its cooldown.

skills.name: Rapid Recharge - Interference
skills.detail: Select an enemy unit and reduce their Auto Skill's charge by {0}%. This does not affect enemies with Skills that take effect over time.

skills.name: Rapid Recharge - Supercharge
skills.detail: Select an ally Doll to cast their Auto Skill immediately. This does not affect its cooldown. Boost their Skill Haste by {1} points for the following {0} seconds.

skills.name: Rapid Charge – Reversal
skills.detail: Select a target and reduce their skill charge by {0}%. Ineffective against enemies with duration-based skills. The target's next skill can be dodged, using characters' own Dodge Rate. Ineffective against enemies with duration-based skills.

skills.name: Rapid Recharge - Whitewater
skills.detail: Select 1 allied Doll and immediately charge their Auto Skill. This does not overwrite their current charge. They gain {1} Skill Haste and deal {2}% more damage with Skills for {0} seconds.

skills.name: Orbital Strike
skills.detail: Deal [Derivative] Operand Damage(equal to {0}% of greatest ally Hashrate) to the enemy with the lowest remaining HP. If the target dies from this strike, restore {1} points of energy.

skills.name: Orbital Strike - Breakpoint
skills.detail: Deal [Derivative] Operand Damage(equal to {0}% of greatest ally Hashrate) to the enemy with the lowest remaining HP. For every {1}% HP the target has lost, the damage dealt is increased by {2}%. If the target dies from this strike, restore {3} points of energy.

skills.name: Orbital Strike - Assault
skills.detail: Deal [Derivative] Operand Damage(equal to {0}% of greatest ally Hashrate) to the enemy with the lowest remaining HP. Boosts all damage dealt for the next {1} seconds by {2}% if target dies from this damage, up to {3} stacks.

skills.name: Orbital Strike – Judgment
skills.detail: Deal damage equal to {0}% of highest ATK/Hashrate to the unit with the lowest HP. That target then takes {1}% increased damage from Ultimates for {2} seconds.

skills.name: Battlefield Interception
skills.detail: Marks 1 enemy of choice to increase its damage received by {1}% for {0} seconds.

skills.name: Battlefield Interception - Increment
skills.detail: Marks 1 selected enemy for {0} seconds. The mark increases its damage received by {1}%, and decreases its Dodge Rate by {2}.

skills.name: Battlefield Interception- Calibration
skills.detail: Marks 1 selected ally, increasing their damage dealt by {1}% for {0} seconds.

skills.name: FC Illumination
skills.detail: Focus fire 1 enemy for {0} seconds. Units do not seek targets again after the duration ends, and ranged units temporarily ignore the Attack Range cap.

skills.name: FC Illumination - Focus
skills.detail: Focus fire 1 enemy for {0} seconds, during which Tactical Skill deal {1}% more damage to it. Units do not seek targets again after the duration ends, and ranged units temporarily ignore the Attack Range cap.

skills.name: FC Illumination - Reflow
skills.detail: Focus fire 1 enemy for {0} seconds, during which allies heal {1}% Max HP when they use a normal attack on it, at most once per ally. Units do not seek targets again after the duration ends, and ranged units temporarily ignore the Attack Range cap.

skills.name: Coordinated Fire
skills.detail: Deals [Derivative] Operand Damage (equal to {0}% of greatest ally Hashrate) to all enemies in the selected area, and stuns them for {1} seconds.

skills.name: Coordinated Fire - Suppression
skills.detail: Deals [Derivative] Operand Damage (equal to {0}% of greatest ally Hashrate) to all enemies within the selected area, stunning them for {1} seconds. Reduces the damage of targets' next {2} Normal Attacks by 10%.

skills.name: Coordinated Fire - Ordnance
skills.detail: Deals [Derivative] Operand Damage (equal to {0}% of greatest ally Hashrate) to all enemies within the selected area, stunning them for {1} seconds. Inflicts an Ignition effect on the enemies that lasts {3} seconds, dealing Operand Damage (equal to {2}% of greatest ally Hashrate) every second.

skills.name: Coordinated Fire – Spiral
skills.detail: Deal Operand Damage equal to {0}% of highest allied Hashrate to enemies within range, stunning them for {2} second(s) and applies {1} stacks of Pyrolysis.

skills.name: Anchor Switch
skills.detail: The selected Doll will not move on their own(Tactical Skills and locational shifts caused by Doll skills are not affected). Use this Skill on the Doll again to remove this effect
